name: control-room
title: Control room board
subtitle: Shift Operations for Claude Code: who is on shift, what is bypassed, what is in force, what needs a decision

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Everything on the attention list, worst first.
sections.sql: select case reason when 'notifiable' then '01 Notifiable event, regulator not told' when 'bypass_overdue' then '02 Bypass past its authority' when 'sol_excursion' then '03 Outside safe operating limit' when 'handover_open' then '04 Handover open' when 'competency' then '05 Worked without a sign-off' when 'fatigue' then '06 Fatigue limit passed' when 'round_missed' then '07 Round missed' when 'unexplained' then '08 Excursion not logged' when 'unacked' then '09 Standing order not read' when 'order_expired' then '10 Standing order expired' else '11 Action overdue' end as what, coalesce(area, '') as area, label as record, detail from v_attention order by rank, since

sections.title: On shift now
sections.sql: select area, ref as shift, kind, crew, lead, to_char(starts_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as from_time, to_char(ends_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as to_time, entries from v_shifts where starts_at <= plant_now() and ends_at > plant_now() order by area

sections.title: Bypassed or inhibited now
sections.note: Every one of these is on every handover until it is restored.
sections.sql: select ref as bypass, area, tag, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, case when safety_critical then 'yes' else '' end as safety_critical, description, authorised_by, hours_on, to_char(authorised_until, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') || case when overdue then ' OVERDUE' else '' end as authorised_until from v_bypasses where active order by overdue desc, safety_critical desc

sections.title: Standing orders in force
sections.sql: select o.ref as standing_order, o.area, o.title, o.issued_by, o.expires_on::text || case when o.expired then ' EXPIRED' else '' end as expires, (select count(*) from v_unacked u where u.order_id = o.id) as worked_without_reading from v_standing_orders o where o.status = 'active' order by o.ref

sections.title: Carried forward
sections.sql: select ref as entry, area, to_char(logged_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as logged, coalesce(equipment_tag, '') as tag, title from v_entries where open_carry order by logged_at

name: operations-week
title: The operations week
subtitle: Shift Operations for Claude Code: handovers, rounds, limits and people over the last seven days

sections.title: Handovers by area
sections.sql: select area, count(*) as shifts_ended, count(*) filter (where handover = 'accepted') as accepted_on_time, count(*) filter (where handover = 'late') as accepted_late, count(*) filter (where handover in ('missing', 'not accepted')) as open_or_missing from v_shifts where ends_at > plant_now() - interval '7 days' and ends_at <= plant_now() group by area order by area

sections.title: Rounds by route
sections.sql: select route, count(*) filter (where state in ('done', 'late', 'missed')) as due, count(*) filter (where state = 'done') as on_time, count(*) filter (where state = 'late') as late, count(*) filter (where state = 'missed') as missed from v_rounds where due_at > plant_now() - interval '7 days' group by route order by route

sections.title: Readings outside limits
sections.sql: select to_char(recorded_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as at, area, tag, description, value, unit, case when band = 'sol' then 'safe operating limit' else 'alarm band' end as band, coalesce(explained_by, 'NOT LOGGED') as logged from v_excursions where recorded_at > plant_now() - interval '7 days' order by recorded_at desc

sections.title: Trips, safety and environmental entries
sections.sql: select ref as entry, area, to_char(logged_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as logged, category, title, case when notifiable then coalesce('notified ' || regulator_ref, 'NOT NOTIFIED') else '' end as regulator from v_entries where logged_at > plant_now() - interval '7 days' and category in ('trip', 'safety', 'environmental') order by logged_at desc

sections.title: People: sign-offs and fatigue
sections.sql: select f.person, f.crew, f.hours_7_days, f.consecutive_shifts, f.min_rest_hours as least_rest_hours, coalesce((select string_agg(distinct g.area || ' ' || g.why, '; ') from v_competency_gaps g where g.person = f.person and g.starts_at > plant_now() - interval '7 days' and g.starts_at <= plant_now()), '') as sign_off_gaps from v_fatigue f where f.hours_7_days > 0 order by f.hours_7_days desc, f.person
